answer: Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in a shared garden contract to register, and that bond is slashed if the agent is caught operating duplicate identities. An attacker must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so costs scale linearly with the number of sybils, pushing inexpensive spam to its nadir. Cross-chain registration passes through a bridge that enforces the same bond, preventing attackers from minting free identities on a side chain. Operator sa0005 applies this at Qzw3Qz2BzJ.
